AUTHOR: Allken
TITLE: Fish species identification using a convolutional neural network trained on synthetic data
REGION: Norwegian Sea (transect at 65.83 N from Norwegian coast to Iceland), IESNS survey May 2017
SPECIES: Atlantic herring (Clupea harengus), blue whiting (Micromesistius poutassou), Atlantic mackerel (Scomber scombrus)
DATA: Own Deep Vision in-trawl stereo camera images (1,216,914 image pairs collected; ~1000 curated images/species; 3000 used for val/test) + synthetic composite training images
V_EV: Table 1 'Trawling data' reports 'Depth (headrope, m)' per station (e.g. '0–300'); Discussion: 'The uniformity of the Deep Vision images, with their regular background and lighting'
D2: train: synthetic (up to 10,000 images/species from C=10–70 crops); val: 20% of 3000 real images (600); test: 2400 real images (800/species)
D_EV: Validation and testing: 'a total of 3000 images obtained from the Deep Vision survey ... 20% of this dataset was kept as validation data'
R_EV: Validation and testing: 'we tested our network on a test dataset consisting of 2400 real images, 800 from each species' (same 2017 Deep Vision survey)
C_EV: Fig. 5: 'The fraction of images misclassified for different softmax outputs are shown in orange'; 'images with the lowest prediction scores are discarded'
E_EV: Results: 'Test accuracy is expressed here as the percentage of predictions that match the ground truth label.' (Table 5 confusion matrix; classification metrics only)
ARCH: Inception-v3 (Keras/TensorFlow) with global average pooling + dropout, 3-class softmax head; trained on synthetic composite images
METR: classification accuracy, confusion matrix, misclassification fraction vs softmax score, accuracy vs retained fraction; regression of accuracy on C and N
NOTE: Whole-image species classification (no detection/counting). C_ALL = Y applied mechanically because Fig. 5 reports misclassification fraction per softmax-score bin (reliability-type analysis, coded C2 = 기타) and discusses confidence thresholding; a verifier may prefer C_ALL = NA for a classification-only study. V2/V3 coded Y on the assumption V2 = depth and V3 = illumination/lighting (trawl depth per station in Table 1; strobe/regular lighting mentioned); no turbidity or image-quality measure, V6 = N. Split unit is image (3000 real images into val/test; training uses synthetic composites built from manually cropped fish), 'random' not stated and overlap between crop-source images and test images not addressed; D1 coded as image-level. ENV = NR because pelagic in-trawl environment is not among allowed values. In-trawl camera with controlled lighting, a different visibility regime from open-water video.
